findings.title: Cached rejected import
findings.body: `mermaidPromise` is cached even when `import('mermaid')` rejects. A transient chunk-load failure (network blip, deploy that rotates chunk hashes) leaves the module-level promise permanently rejected. Every later README with a diagram is then flagged as an error until a full page reload, with no retry. Clear `mermaidPromise` on rejection, e.g. `.catch((e) => { mermaidPromise = undefined; throw e; })`.

findings.title: Pinned transitive dep
findings.body: The resolution `mermaid/@braintree/sanitize-url` forces an exact `7.0.1`. Recent mermaid 11.x releases appear to declare `^7.1.x` for this package, so the pin may downgrade mermaid's URL sanitizer below its declared range. This could break link and URL handling inside diagrams or drop fixes mermaid relies on. I'm not sure of mermaid 11.16.0's exact declared range. Check it, and justify this override or remove it.
